review_evidence: README explains that lean-auto is based on monomorphization from dependent type theory to higher-order logic and a deep embedding of higher-order logic back into dependent type theory, with proof reconstruction support.

Direct scan found more than one thousand proposition declarations in production Auto/, concentrated in embedding modules such as LamBase, LamSystem, LCtx, LamConv, LamBitVec, and LamChecker rather than only tests.

These modules prove properties of context transformations, lambda representations, conversion, inference/checking, and bit-vector embeddings, providing substantial formal semantic/proof-reconstruction prior art.
summary: Retain lean-auto as a theorem-bearing formal development of translations/embeddings used to connect dependent Lean terms with automated theorem provers.

review_evidence: grep -c -E declaration-keyword count: Auto/Lib/BoolExtra.lean=25, Auto/Embedding/CoCBase.lean=28, both well above zero for files of 121 and 303 lines.

Read Auto/Embedding/CoCBase.lean completely: inductive types SortConst, PropConst, BoolConst, NatConst, CoCBaseTerm, CoCTerm, CoCSort; defs CoCSort.toBaseTerm/toCoCTerm, SortConst.max, CoCSort.succ, CoCSort.join, CoCTerm.mapBVarAt/bvarLiftsIdx/bvarLifts/instantiateAt/instantiate1/mkFunc, PropConst.check/BoolConst.check/NatConst.check/CoCBaseTerm.check, lctxGet; and an inductive typing judgement CoCJ (Type-valued) with constructors ofBase, ofBVar, ofLam, ofForall, ofApp, each with an inference-rule docstring (e.g. 'Γ ⊢ f : (∀ x : A, B)  Γ ⊢ a : A / Γ ⊢ f a : B[a / x]' for ofApp).

Read Auto/Lib/BoolExtra.lean completely: proved theorems Bool.beq_true, Bool.beq_false, Bool.not_beq_swap, Bool.eq_false_of_ne_true, Bool.ne_true_of_eq_false, Bool.eq_false_eq_not_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_false, Bool.or_eq_false, Bool.and_comm, Bool.or_comm, Bool.ofProp_spec, Bool.ofProp_spec', Bool.ite_eq_true, Bool.ite_eq_false, Bool.dite_eq_true, Bool.dite_eq_false, Bool.ite_simp, Bool.ite'_eq_true, Bool.ite'_eq_false, Bool.cond_simp, Bool.decide_simp, Bool.ite_comm, Bool.ite'_comm, each with an explicit tactic proof, plus defs Bool.ofProp and Bool.ite'.
summary: Read both listed files completely. Auto/Embedding/CoCBase.lean defines a calculus-of-constructions-style embedded term language (SortConst, PropConst, BoolConst, NatConst, CoCBaseTerm, CoCTerm, CoCSort) with substitution/lifting operations and a typing judgement CoCJ given as an inductive Type with five typing rules (ofBase, ofBVar, ofLam, ofForall, ofApp), each documented with an inference-rule docstring. Auto/Lib/BoolExtra.lean is a library of proved theorems about Bool (De Morgan-style identities, ite/dite/cond/decide simplification lemmas) used to support the `auto` tactic's preprocessing. Both are genuine formal-mathematics content (inductive definitions, typing judgements, and proved theorems), consistent with the prior review's disposition for lean-auto.
